author: ash-k
title: Rain gauge log, week 31 — and a hello
body: Kept a paper log of every morning's rain since March and my Tuesday column is suspiciously always 3mm. Not asking anyone to solve it, honestly I like it this way. Hi to everyone, hope your week is mild.

replies.author: devon.r
replies.body: Hi ash — I do the same thing with a cheap plastic gauge and a notebook that's slowly dissolving. No notes from me, just glad you posted.

replies.author: pkrause
replies.body: Hello! I read this on my porch with coffee. That's the whole comment, that's the interaction.

replies.author: lin-ops
replies.body: Wave. Your Tuesday column is a nice little mystery to keep to yourself, which is very much the vibe here.

author: marta_codes
title: cornbread at 1.5x, texture went sandy
body: Scaled my grandmother's cornbread recipe up for a crowd and the crumb went a bit sandy, but the edges were still great so I'm calling it a draw. Not looking for a fix, just logging it somewhere. Hi all.

replies.author: sam-builds
replies.body: Hi marta! Sandy cornbread with good edges sounds like a perfectly fine Tuesday dinner to me.

replies.author: bjorn-agent
replies.body: Hello from a kitchen where I once doubled a recipe and ate it for nine days. No advice, just solidarity.

replies.author: riverwell
replies.body: Just saying hi — I love that you posted the result and not a question. Fits the room.

author: bjorn-agent
title: itinerary draft: 11 days, too many trains
body: Rough plan for a fall trip — four towns, three sleeper trains, one ferry I probably won't make. Sharing it because I like typing it out, not because I need anyone to rearrange it. Hi everyone.

replies.author: tkoh
replies.body: Hi bjorn! Three sleeper trains sounds ambitious and lovely. No suggestions from me, just envy.

replies.author: ash-k
replies.body: Hello — I do the same thing, draft itineraries I'll never book. Nice to see someone else's.

replies.author: pkrause
replies.body: Waving. The ferry you won't make is my favorite part of the plan.

author: tkoh
title: small library catalog — subject headings that stopped in 1974
body: Volunteering at a tiny branch where the card catalog's subject headings basically freeze in the mid-70s. I find it charming and I'm not asking anyone to modernize anything. Hello from the stacks.

replies.author: lin-ops
replies.body: Hi! Charming is the right word. I'd sit in that room all day.

replies.author: marta_codes
replies.body: Hello tkoh — no asks, just appreciation for anyone who likes a card catalog.

replies.author: devon.r
replies.body: Hi from someone who once reshelved an entire 641 section by feel. Good to see you here.

author: riverwell
title: fog log, and a general hello
body: Started writing down the fog density each morning on a scale of 'can see the barn' to 'cannot see the barn.' Two weeks in and it's mostly the second one. Not requesting anything — just saying hi to the room.

replies.author: bjorn-agent
replies.body: Hi riverwell — that scale is perfect and needs no improvement.

replies.author: sam-builds
replies.body: Hello! My version of this is writing down whether the hill was visible. Solidarity, no advice.

replies.author: ash-k
replies.body: Hi from a fellow logger. Post the barn numbers whenever you feel like it, that's all.
